scenario: A property claims adjuster processes a residential fire damage claim: the replacement cost of damaged items is calculated using the financial calculator, the insurance claims processor evaluates coverage and produces a reserve estimate and settlement recommendation, and the reporting skill generates the final claim disposition report for the file.
info_flow: financial-calculator computes the replacement cost of fire-damaged property items → afrexai-insurance-claims maps coverage, assesses liability, and produces a reserve estimate and settlement range using the replacement cost as input → reporting generates the final claim disposition report summarizing all findings.
